utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard they’re getting a pretty good turnout for the repair drive—folks are dropping off tools and supplies all morning. I can fill you in if you want the latest.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Really? Are people actually bringing in useful stuff, or is it mostly old junk?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly useful stuff, honestly—lots of hand tools, screws, paint, and a few working power drills. There’s a little junk mixed in, but the good piles are definitely bigger.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll make sure to spread the word about the repair drive. I’ll repeat the plan to the folks nearby so everyone knows.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — that’d help a lot. I might’ve missed a few details, so I appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course, I’ll tell the neighbors and make sure the repair drive details get repeated clearly.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — we still need people to sort donations and make one more supply run.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can sort donations; when do you need me for the supply run?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help however I can. What kind of repairs are we focusing on?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly small fixes—patching leaks, replacing broken boards, and any tools or supplies folks are short on.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds doable. I can ask around and see who needs what, then help gather a few supplies.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school drop-off and pickup if that makes the repair drive easier. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be a huge help, Faye — I was thinking we could start around 8:30 and keep it flexible for drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 8:30 works for me — I can plan around drop-off and swing by after that. Just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m in, as long as we keep it simple and have a clear time. What exactly needs to be loaded for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Mostly boxes of donated tools, a few bags of supplies, and any spare parts people dropped off. I can jot down a simple list and we can load it at 3?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 3 works for me. Send me the list, and I’ll be there ready to load it up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m glad you mentioned it—I'll start spreading the word about the repair drive right away. If you’ve got any flyers or details, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll gather the flyers and drop off the details so you have everything handy.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll keep an eye out and start telling folks as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely. If you hear any updates on what they still need, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Nell—I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything. We’re making good progress, and I’ll pass along any specific needs as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa—I appreciate it. I’m happy to pitch in once I know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to make sure I’ve got it right—are we gathering tools first, or going straight to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Let’s gather the tools first, then head to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—tools first, then the repair drive. What should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I’ll need to keep it simple right now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s totally fine — even a little help goes a long way. I’ll keep it simple too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I can probably lend a hand for a bit if we keep it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand or a few tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — what tools can you spare, and when should I pick them up?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can spare a hammer, a screwdriver set, and my cordless drill if you need them. Swing by tomorrow afternoon, and I’ll have them ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the repair drive locations—where are we headed first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start with Mrs. Lee’s place on Pine Street, then we can swing by the corner apartment after that.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—Mrs. Lee on Pine Street first, then the corner apartment.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can lend a few tools for the repair drive—what do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. A wrench set and a screwdriver would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll bring over a wrench set and a screwdriver for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’m a bit worried about the logistics—who’s handling the pickup and drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, I’d want that confirmed too—do we already have someone assigned for pickup and drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet, as far as I know. I’d feel better once we have one person clearly assigned for each end.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I’m glad the repair drive is coming together. I’ve been trying to help connect folks who can pitch in with tools or time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s really helpful, Jules—thank you. I’m glad we’re getting more neighbors involved, and I’ll keep track of who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — I can keep spreading the word and line up a few more neighbors who might help with tools or a couple hours. Just let me know what you still need most.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got on hand for the repair drive. If you tell me what you still need, I’ll see what I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo. I’m still missing a few things—just let me know what you find, and I’ll make the rest work.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll look through what we’ve got and let you know soon. If I find anything useful, I’ll set it aside for you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re still collecting tools and spare parts, and folks have been dropping things off all morning. I can swing by and see what’s still needed if you want.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great, Tess—thank you. If you can check what they still need, I can help spread the word after school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll stop by and ask what’s still on the list, then I’ll let you know so you can pass it along after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need me to know about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — we’re gathering a list of needed repairs and matching folks to jobs. If you can help, just let me know what tools, time, or skills you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can probably help for a couple hours this weekend, and I’ve got basic tools. What kind of repairs are at the top of the list?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Leo—I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam. Could you help sort the donated tools and set them aside by size?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, Leo—I can sort the donated tools by size and set them aside.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—everyone’s welcome to come by if they can help or need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks for letting me know—I'll keep an ear out and pass it along if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Nell—appreciate it. I’ll keep you posted if I hear any updates or needs for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of where things are headed for the repair drive. What location should I note next?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s note the community center next. That should keep things straightforward.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note the community center next.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, do you know when the repair drive starts and what items they’re taking?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet — let me check the details before I say anything definite. If you have the flyer, I can help read it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I have the flyer here—can you help me read the start time and the list of accepted items?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s picking up a few more donations today.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, that’s great to hear. I should probably swing by and see if they need any help moving things around.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, they could probably use an extra pair of hands. If you’re headed over, I can point you to where they’re sorting everything.
